effect: A larger shadow economy lowers tax collection: collection efficiency (or) is multiplied by 1 - (shadow share of GDP - its day-0 share), from shadowMarket.byCountry[country]. The game bounds the share between 0.45x its day-0 value and 8% of GDP, so efficiency moves by at most a few percent; a shrinking shadow economy raises collection slightly. Not included: debiting shadow spending from households or GDP. Day 0 unchanged (the gap is 0); a country without shadow-market data is unchanged. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26296134; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
